description.value: Shoom Restaurant is a Hong Kong-style Chinese eatery on Fraser Street in south Vancouver, seating up to 90 guests and serving a full menu of dishes including salted egg yolk prawns, Peking duck, house special chicken, and a broad range of Hong Kong-style beverages. The restaurant accepts table reservations and offers online ordering via Instagram, making it a substantial sit-down meal option for cyclists passing through the Fraser Street corridor.
